# Evolution writing back: an edit, a completion, a create without
# If-None-Match and a delete. Written from published client behaviour,
# not captured traffic: Evolution's CalDAV backend sends If-Match with the ETag
# it holds, may save a new task with no If-None-Match at all, writes the
# whole object with its own X-EVOLUTION properties, and fetches the object
# again after a PUT answered without an ETag.

### the ETags at depth 1
PROPFIND {infra}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
SAVE etag1 {infra}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag

### editing the summary and the description
PUT {infra}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag1}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
PRODID:-//Ximian//NONSGML Evolution Calendar//EN
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
DTSTAMP:20260101T090000Z
SUMMARY:Rotate the keys
DESCRIPTION:Both regions\, then the backups.
STATUS:NEEDS-ACTION
PRIORITY:0
CLASS:PUBLIC
X-EVOLUTION-CALDAV-HREF:{infra}{open1}.ics
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 title Rotate the keys

### fetched again
GET {infra}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS DESCRIPTION:Both regions\, then the backups.
HAS CLASS:PUBLIC
SAVEHEADER etag2 ETag

### marking it complete
PUT {infra}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag2}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:Rotate the keys
DESCRIPTION:Both regions\, then the backups.
STATUS:COMPLETED
COMPLETED:20260101T100000Z
PERCENT-COMPLETE:100
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 status done

### a new task saved without If-None-Match
PUT {infra}20260101T110000Z-4242-1000-1-0@laptop.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:20260101T110000Z-4242-1000-1-0@laptop
DTSTAMP:20260101T110000Z
SUMMARY:Book the venue
DUE;VALUE=DATE:20260201
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 201
TASK Book_the_venue due 2026-02-01T00:00Z

### the new task by its own name
GET {infra}20260101T110000Z-4242-1000-1-0@laptop.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS UID:20260101T110000Z-4242-1000-1-0@laptop

### deleting the other task
DELETE {infra}{open2}.ics

EXPECT 204
TASK open2 status cancelled
TASK open2 trashed false
